form.billingKindOneTimeHint: Customer charged once at engagement signup. No further invoices on this engagement.
form.billingKindRecurringHint: Billed every cycle. Engagement auto-renews until cancelled.
form.billingKindContractHint: Fixed-term engagement with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at signup.
form.billingKindMilestoneHint: Invoice fires per milestone (engagement phase) as deliverables complete. Requires an Engagement Template on the parent Package.
form.billingKindAdHocHint: Operator-requested service calls. Choose Total Package for a prepaid retainer or Per service call for pay-per-call.
form.amountBasisPerCycleHint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Contract-with-cycle engagements.
form.amountBasisTotalPackageHint: Single total amount charged across the full engagement term. One invoice covers everything; no per-cycle billing.
form.amountBasisDerivedFromLinesHint: Total computed automatically from the per-item rate-card rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amountBasisPerOccurrenceHint: Amount charged per delivered service call. On-call engagements only — each call fires its own invoice.
form.entitledOccurrencesInfo: Number of service calls included in the prepaid retainer. Required when amount basis is Total Package on an On-call engagement.
form.termOpenEndedHelp: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.scheduleLockedTooltip: This rate card is reserved for {{.ClientName}}.
form.scheduleAutoCreateHint: No rate card exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.scheduleAutoReuseHint: This package will be added to the existing rate card for {{.ClientName}}.
form.scheduleClientPickerNotice: Only packages assigned to this client are available below.
form.scheduleGeneralPickerNotice: Packages assigned specifically to clients are not available for assignment to general-scoped rate cards.
form.parentScheduleClientNotice: This rate card belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Packages created here will be available only for engagements with this client.

productPrice.emptyMsg: No service prices have been configured for this rate card yet.

messages.pricingLockedReason: This package is in use by active engagements. Pricing changes are disabled. You can still rename or reassign the package.
messages.itemPricingLockedReason: This package is in use by active engagements. Item price and currency are locked to keep billing consistent.
messages.createNotAvailable: Service price plan create is not available.
messages.updateNotAvailable: Service price plan update is not available.
messages.deleteNotAvailable: Service price plan delete is not available.
messages.inUseCannotModify: This package is in use by active engagements. Item price and currency are locked.

confirms.editAmountMultipleEngagements: This rate card is attached to {{.Count}} active engagements for {{.ClientName}}. Changing the amount or cycle will affect all of them on the next bill cycle. Continue?

errors.inUse: This plan is in use by active engagements and cannot be deleted.
errors.scheduleClientMismatch: Selected rate card belongs to a different client and cannot be attached to this price plan.
errors.scheduleRequiredForClientScope: This package is scoped to a client. Pick or create a rate card for that client before adding a price plan.

validation.milestoneCyclicBlock: Milestone billing is not supported on cyclic packages (RECURRING / CONTRACT × PER_CYCLE / multi-visit).
validation.adHocInvalidBasis: On-call engagements require amount basis = Total Package (retainer) or Per service call.
validation.adHocBillingIncompatibleWithCycleCadence: On-call engagements cannot have a billing cycle.
validation.adHocVisitsPerCycleMustBeOne: On-call engagements cannot use multi-visit cycles.
validation.adHocPoolNoTemplate: On-call retainer engagements require the Package to have an Engagement Template.
validation.adHocPerCallNoTemplate: Per-call engagements require the Package to have an Engagement Template.
validation.adHocEntitlementRequired: On-call retainer engagements require entitled service calls > 0.
validation.adHocEntitlementInvalidForPerCall: Entitled service calls are only valid on retainer engagements, not per-call.

perCycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}}. Engagement auto-renews until cancelled.
perCycle.operations: Each cycle spawns {{.VisitsPerCycle}} engagement Job(s) (if Package has an Engagement Template). Work Plans tab shows cycle accordions.
perCycle.revenue: One invoice per cycle. Generate Invoice creates the invoice and (via piggyback) spawns the engagement Job if missing.

derivedFromLines.operations: Each cycle spawns 1+ engagement Jobs. Operations tracking flows through the Package's Engagement Template.
derivedFromLines.revenue: Invoice total computed from rate card lines; one invoice per cycle.

totalPackage.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime engagement Job (or cycle Jobs if cyclic — see Package's visits_per_cycle).
totalPackage.revenue: One invoice at signup; cycle Jobs are operational only.

totalPackage.operations: Lifetime engagement Job with phases. BillingEvent rows gate per-milestone invoicing.
totalPackage.revenue: Invoice per milestone trigger; sum across milestones equals the total package.

totalPackage.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime engagement Job with phases (if Package has an Engagement Template).
totalPackage.revenue: One invoice at engagement signup covering the full amount.

totalPackage.operations: Operator requests each service call from the Work Plans tab. Retainer exhausts after {{.EntitledOccurrences}} calls — operator can extend.
totalPackage.revenue: One invoice at engagement signup covering the entire retainer; subsequent service calls are operationally tracked only.

perOccurrence.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} per service call. No upfront cost.
perOccurrence.operations: Operator requests each service call from the Work Plans tab. Each completed call flips its BillingEvent to READY for invoicing.
perOccurrence.revenue: One invoice per delivered service call. Generate Invoice per call row.

warning.milestoneNoTemplate: Milestone billing requires the Package to have an Engagement Template. Configure it on the Package first.
warning.recurringNoTemplate: This engagement will not have operational tracking. Add an Engagement Template to the Package to enable cycle Jobs.
warning.visitsPerCycleInvalidKind: visits_per_cycle is only valid for cyclic packages. Reset to 1 or change the billing kind.
warning.adHocPoolNoTemplate: On-call retainer engagements require an Engagement Template so service calls can be tracked.
warning.adHocPerCallNoTemplate: Per-call engagements require an Engagement Template so service calls can be tracked.
warning.adHocNoEntitlement: On-call retainer engagements need entitled service calls > 0. Set the value or switch to per-call billing.
warning.adHocBillingCycleNotAllowed: On-call engagements are event-driven, not calendar-driven. Remove the billing cycle.
warning.adHocVisitsPerCycleNotAllowed: On-call engagements cannot use multi-visit cycles. Reset visits_per_cycle to 1.

subscriptions.emptyMessage: Engagements billing this package will appear here.
subscriptions.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete engagement %s? This action cannot be undone.
